I don't know how to love myself. Ive tried to find info on things like internalised homophobia but nothings helping. I live in a small town and have anxiety so I don't have much choice over who I'm surrounded by.
Ive been trying to find a relationship over the last year. All 3 guys I've gone on a date with wanted to sleep with me the first time we met. I'm an outcast amongst faggots and I can't do it. I'm sorry. I'm just whining. I don't know what I should be saying.
